image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a wood rabbit (cottontail) sitting in a grassy field. The rabbit has greyish-brown fur, long upright ears with dark tips, and large dark eyes. It is facing slightly to the right. A prominent 'iStockphoto' watermark overlays the center of the image.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Ears are clearly visible, upright, and show distinct dark coloration at the tips. Proportions appear consistent with a cottontail.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large laterally positioned eyes providing wide field of view.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible eye is large, dark, and positioned on the side of the head, consistent with prey animal anatomy.
